entries.en: to covet what belongs to others; to be covetous
entries.notes: 汉字栏带[疑:妬/婪]，依官话对音栏与西语词头 Codiciar cosas ajenas 取“婪”义。

entries.en: to covet; to scheme after something desired

entries.zh: 心想；心中妄求（心内贪想）
entries.en: to covet in one's heart; to mentally desire

entries.zh: 贪冒；贪求非分之物，存心不良
entries.en: to covet wrongfully, beyond one's due; to desire ill
entries.notes: 西语词头 gmal 系缩写，按 desear mal（盼人遭殃）推断展开，与汉字“貪冒”相合。

entries.zh: 噬人；吞食盘剥他人（巧取吸食他人之财）
entries.en: to devour or prey upon others; to strip and suck dry what belongs to them

entries.zh: 唯钱是图（心里只有钱）；贪财吝啬
entries.en: money-mad, thinking of nothing but money; avaricious, miserly
entries.notes: 西语词头 arador avaro nancip 讹乱难解；依汉字“係是錢”与对音栏取“唯钱是图”义。

entries.en: (of a mandarin) to take bribes and commit graft; to covet illicit gains
entries.notes: 官话栏带[疑:tan chāng/fon chang]且西语词头讹乱；依汉字“貪贓”与 mandarin 语境定为贪赃受贿。

entries.zh: 恋恋不舍；贪恋无餍（过度贪婪）
entries.notes: “年”字与西语义对应不明（或为衬字），依“戀戀”及三音节对音取“贪恋不舍”义。

entries.zh: 抢钱；贪得无厌，凡物皆欲
entries.en: to grab or snatch money; greedy, wanting everything

entries.zh: 重利；贪利无餍（放债取重、盘剥取利）
entries.en: usurious, taking heavy interest; greedy for gain
Chinese foot (chi), unit of length; a measuring rule
entries.notes: 西语词头 Codemedir 疑为 codo（肘尺）加 medir（量）之连写，依汉字“尺”与对音栏定为长度单位。

entries.zh: 以手、脚量度（以手拃与脚步量长短）
entries.en: to measure by hand-span and foot-step; a way of measuring
entries.notes: 汉字“手後腳”与官话栏末音节不对应，闽南语栏又有 que/re 两读，语义无法定夺，暂按量度语境拟释。
汉字栏与闽南语栏均为[空]，官话栏 lom day. 与西语词头 cod del Graco（疑指肘尺）无从互证。
官话栏带[疑:hi/lu]，依汉字“賂”与西语 cohecho 定为贿赂义。

entries.en: illicit gains, bribe money (of a mandarin); graft

entries.zh: 后手；暗中经手受贿（背后接钱之手）
entries.en: the backhand — the hand taking behind one's back; a bribe-taker or go-between

entries.zh: 手捻内；攥紧手中所得（把贿物捏在手心）
entries.en: to clench the hand over what it holds inside; to grasp and keep a bribe in hand

entries.zh: 后手钱；暗中交递的贿钱
